tasks.name: Fix Layout Overflows
tasks.developer_request: This screen overflows on small phones. Fix it properly.
tasks.evaluates: Finding the root cause of a runtime layout bug and fixing it with bounded or scrollable layouts, rather than hiding the error.

tasks.name: Adapt to Material and Cupertino
tasks.developer_request: Make the app feel native on iOS, and adapt its navigation for tablets and desktop.
tasks.evaluates: Material 3 and Cupertino widgets for each platform, navigation that adapts to window width rather than device type, and per-tab navigation state that survives layout changes.

tasks.name: Fetch Data from a REST API
tasks.developer_request: Load the restaurant list from our API instead of the hard-coded data, and handle network failures.
tasks.evaluates: Using `package:http` correctly: one shared, injected `Client`, a timeout on every request, status code checks, typed immutable models, and loading, empty, and error states in the UI.

tasks.name: Manage State with Provider
tasks.developer_request: Add a shopping cart that's shared across screens, using provider.
tasks.evaluates: Where shared state lives, which widgets rebuild when it changes, and using `provider` the way its docs recommend. Transient UI state, such as animations or focus, stays out of app state.

tasks.name: Add Firebase Storage Photos
tasks.developer_request: Let users upload, view, download, and delete their photos, with everything stored in Firebase.
tasks.evaluates: Firebase setup and the `firebase_storage` API: per-user file paths, upload progress and metadata, error handling, and security rules that limit access to each user's files.

tasks.name: Persist Sessions with Secure Storage
tasks.developer_request: Users get logged out every time they restart the app. Keep them signed in, but store their tokens securely.
tasks.evaluates: The current `flutter_secure_storage` API and platform setup, restoring the session on cold start, clearing tokens on sign-out, and never writing tokens to logs or `shared_preferences`.

tasks.name: Build an AI Backend with Genkit Dart
tasks.developer_request: Add a backend endpoint in Dart with Genkit that suggests three meals from the ingredients a user has.
tasks.evaluates: The current Genkit Dart 1.x API: a typed flow, a tool, structured output, input validation, model error handling, and API keys kept out of code.

tasks.name: Add Unit, Widget, and Integration Tests
tasks.developer_request: This checkout flow has no tests. Add unit, widget, and integration tests so we can change it safely.
tasks.evaluates: Whether the tests catch seeded bugs, use the right level for each behavior, fake dependencies, and run deterministically without sleeps.

tasks.name: Add Localization
tasks.developer_request: We're launching in Spain and Saudi Arabia. Translate the whole app into Spanish and Arabic.
tasks.evaluates: The current `gen-l10n` setup with ARB files, plurals and placeholders, locale-aware dates and prices, right-to-left layout, and localized framework widgets such as date pickers and dialogs.

tasks.name: Add Web Support
tasks.developer_request: Our app only runs on Android and iOS. Ship it on the mobile web.
tasks.evaluates: Removing web blockers such as `dart:io` and unsupported plugins, shareable URLs, browser back and refresh, text selection, and PWA setup. Out of scope: desktop layouts and mouse or keyboard input.

tasks.name: Add Deep Links with go_router
tasks.developer_request: Make links from emails and notifications open the right screen, with a working back button.
tasks.evaluates: A `go_router` route tree with path and query parameters, a not-found route, an onboarding redirect, and web-to-app links (Android App Links and iOS Universal Links). Out of scope: custom URL schemes, browser URLs, and sign-in guards.

tasks.name: Persist the Cart with shared_preferences
tasks.developer_request: The cart empties every time the app restarts. Keep it on the device so people can pick up where they left off.
tasks.evaluates: The current `shared_preferences` API, versioned serialization that tolerates missing or corrupt data, restoring the cart before it's shown, and storage behind a repository. Out of scope: secure storage.

tasks.name: Add Firebase Authentication
tasks.developer_request: Add Firebase sign-in. Browsing stays public, but checkout and profile need an account.
tasks.evaluates: Firebase Auth setup, route guards without redirect loops, relying on Firebase's built-in session persistence, auth error handling, and isolating each account's data, including carrying a guest's cart over on sign-in.

tasks.name: Build a Greenfield Fitness App
tasks.developer_request: Implement a Flutter fitness app from this product spec.
tasks.evaluates: End-to-end app development over many turns, covering project structure, architecture, UI, and data across many CUJs in a single project.
